area: Output inductor L1 design and selection (400 V -> 200 V, 5 kW, 25 A, 50 kHz SiC synchronous buck)
summary: The selected custom choke (2 x Magnetics 0058192A2 High Flux 60u, 34 T AWG 10) rests on primary data that all check out: the 0058192A2 datasheet (rev 10/6/2021) confirms AL 138 nH +/-8 %, OD 58.04 max / ID 25.58 min / HT 16.13 max mm, Ae 229 mm2, le 125 mm, Ve 28,600 mm3, Wa 514 mm2, 218 g, DC-bias minimum 80 % at 90 Oe / 50 % at 170 Oe, 900 mW/cm3 max at 100 kHz / 100 mT, 3000 VAC wire-to-wire, 200 degC coating, Curie 500 degC, 120 cm2 surface at 40 % WF; the 2024 catalogue (downloaded, 12 MB) confirms the High Flux 60u permeability fit (0.01, 6.413E-08, 2.291; p.63), core-loss fit (246.54, 2.218, 1.311; p.109), DC-magnetisation fit (p.129/130), the dT = (mW/cm2)^0.833 model, Bsat 1.5 T, 4.5 % permeability shift -60..200 degC, relative cost 4x-6x, and 'DC bias does not cause core loss'. Every number in the agent's chain was recomputed and agrees within rounding (L(25 A) 272.5 uH, L(41 A) 208 uH, dI 7.34 App at 400 V, Pcore 5.93 W, Rdc 16.04 mohm at 100 degC, dT 50.2 K, P_max 28.7 W, IPC-2221 9.5 mm, via 1.22 A, TDK AL 254 nH). The Coilcraft AGP4233-224ME, Vishay IHXL-1500VZ-3A, Vishay IHDM-1008BC, Hammond 195C30 and TDK E70/33/32 rejections are confirmed from fetched datasheets. Corrections: the core-loss estimate uses the typical Steinmetz fit, which gives 625 mW/cm3 at the datasheet's 100 kHz / 100 mT spec point against a guaranteed maximum of 900 (1.44x), so a worst-case core raises the 440 V / 27.5 A loss from 19.8 W to about 23 W and the natural-convection hot spot to about 112 degC, above the agent's own 110 degC acceptance line; the '+/-30 %' accuracy attributed to the catalogue's dT model is not in the source; the WE-HCF 7443641000 current ratings are mislabelled; the TDK coil-former lN 230.5 mm belongs to a different former; Hammond does list the 195C30 weight (6 lb); PE-PCB-005/006 are not retrievable through the knowledge query tool; the 2024 catalogue selector table lists the size as 'C058192A2' and procurement must confirm the orderable prefix. None of these overturns the selection.

knowledge_misuse: PE-PCB-005 and PE-PCB-006 are listed as 'top_hits' of a 'python -m automation.knowledge.query --get' command, but the tool returns 'unknown id' for both; they exist only as project rules in docs/pcb-design-rules.md and automation/verification/pcb_rules.json (the agent's reading of their content is correct).
SKILL-003's exclusion was quoted as 'inductor-ripple output filters' without its qualifier 'of low-voltage converters'; the conclusion (do not apply the capacitor equations to the inductor) stands.

The '+/-30 %' accuracy of the dT = (mW/cm2)^0.833 model is presented as the catalogue's 'own caveat'; the catalogue and design guide only say 'useful approximation for a component in still air' / 'no simple way to predict temperature rise precisely'.

The decision-10 paraphrase 'magnetics placed where they do not lengthen electrical loops' is SKILL-006 principle wording, not text of the TIDA-010054 analysis; and KR-PCB-005 (gate-driver adjacency) is stretched as an 'analogy' for the SW-lead length - acceptable only because it is labelled as such.

No reference instance value was copied as a design value: TI's 40 degC ambient, heat sinks and pads were not reused (50 degC from the design basis), and the V1 285 g inductor is used only as a mechanical-support pattern.
required_changes: Add a datasheet-maximum core-loss case: the 0058192A2 guarantee (900 mW/cm3 at 100 kHz / 100 mT) is 1.44x the Steinmetz fit used (625 mW/cm3 at that point). Worst-case Pcore becomes about 8.5 W at 400 V and 10.4 W at 440 V, total 440 V / 27.5 A loss about 23 W, still-air dT about 62 K and hot spot about 112 degC at 50 degC ambient - above the agent's own 110 degC acceptance line though below the 125 degC design limit (P_max 28.7 W). Make the 2-stack vs 3-stack decision rule and the thermal-test acceptance refer to this case (or credit forced air with a measurement plan).
Remove the attribution of '+/-30 %' to the Magnetics catalogue for the temperature-rise model; retain it, if wanted, as an explicit own assumption.
Correct the WE-HCF 7443641000 candidate: 34.95 A = IR (dT 50 K), 32.6 A = IRP (dT 40 K), 37 A = ISAT at 10 % drop; the datasheet has no 30 % saturation rating; DCR max 2.64 mohm remains unverified.

Correct the TDK coil-former data in the ferrite option: B66372A2000T001 lists AN 389 mm2 and no lN; lN 230.5 mm belongs to B66372B1000T001 (one core set, AN 456 mm2); use B66372B2000T001 (AN 389 mm2, lN 209 mm, two core sets) for the two-set estimate.
Hammond 195C30: replace 'weight not found' with Hammond's listed shipping weight 6 lb (2.72 kg).
Upgrade the Vishay IHDM-1008BC-x0 entry to 'fetched-datasheet' (Document 34522, Revision 30-Sep-2026; members 1.2-8.2 uH, 180 degC, powdered iron alloy core).

Fix the knowledge-query section: cite PE-PCB-005/006 from docs/pcb-design-rules.md and automation/verification/pcb_rules.json instead of listing them as --get hits; quote the SKILL-003 exclusion in full.

Add a procurement note: the 2024 catalogue selector table lists this size as 'C058192A2' while the datasheet and cross-reference use '0058192A2'; confirm the orderable part number and prefix meaning with Magnetics (no distributor stock was found).

Cite the DC-magnetisation fit as catalogue p.129/130 (pdf page 131) and name IEC 60664-1 Table F.5 (creepage, 4.0 mm at 400 V / PD2 / group III) and Table F.2 (clearance, 3.0 mm at 4 kV impulse) explicitly for the 4 mm terminal spacing.
